verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five shackles of the heart.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
verses.english: Firstly, a mendicant isn’t free of greed, desire, fondness, thirst, passion, and craving for sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho, tassa cittaṁ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
verses.english: This being so, their mind doesn’t incline toward keenness, commitment, persistence, and striving.

verses.pali: Yassa cittaṁ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṁ paṭhamo cetasovinibandho.
verses.english: This is the first shackle of the heart.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti …pe…
verses.english: Furthermore, a mendicant isn’t free of greed for the body …
They’re not free of greed for form …

verses.pali: yāvadatthaṁ udarāvadehakaṁ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṁ passasukhaṁ middhasukhaṁ anuyutto viharati …pe…
verses.english: They eat as much as they like until their belly is full, then indulge in the pleasures of sleeping, lying down, and drowsing …

verses.pali: aññataraṁ devanikāyaṁ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṁ carati: ‘imināhaṁ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti.
verses.english: They lead the spiritual life hoping to be reborn in one of the orders of gods, thinking: ‘By this precept or observance or fervent austerity or spiritual practice, may I become one of the gods!’

verses.pali: Yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ devanikāyaṁ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṁ carati: ‘imināhaṁ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti, tassa cittaṁ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
verses.english: This being so, their mind doesn’t incline toward keenness, commitment, persistence, and striving.

verses.pali: Yassa cittaṁ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṁ pañcamo cetasovinibandho.
verses.english: This is the fifth shackle of the heart.
These are the five shackles of the heart.”
